repos_data.description: Read and analyze SEC EDGAR filings in Python. 10-K, 8-K, XBRL financials, Form 3/4/5, 13F, ADV — clean API, well-typed, MIT-licensed.

Open-source, Bloomberg-style stock dashboard for the terminal: live quotes and candlestick charts next to AI-scored news, SEC Form 4 insider filings and earnings reads from AlphAI. One Rust binary on ratatui.
Official Python SDK for the Earnings Feed API - SEC filings, insider transactions, and institutional holdings
